messages:
jess (sales): Mercator just sent a POC ask — they want a perf run and a cost/security writeup. Goals: sustained 400 QPS for 30m, p95 <120ms, active in NA + EU, and a fallback plan to dedicated capacity if hosted throttles. Also need answers for KMS/HSM, SSO, and an enterprise onboarding blocker (contracts). Can eng propose a heatmap + jitter sweep and ops runbook?

matt (eng-reliability): We can do it. Need model + avg prompt/output sizes and ratio of generate vs embed. Also confirm whether they want streaming responses (affects latency).

ben (solutions): From discovery: model = open-llama-13b/opt-13b equivalent; they'll try both a fp16 and q4 variant. Typical input ~45 tokens, output ~130 tokens. Workload: ~70% text-gen, 30% embeddings/rerank. Streaming = yes for gen paths.

kala (eng-runtime): OK — that'll be batching-sensitive. Plan: run a mixed-workload sweep: steady-state 100/200/300/400 QPS, plus 1m and 5m microbursts (x2). Measure p50/p95/p99 and kernel saturation. I'll test both quantized and fp16 variants and capture KV-cache hit rates.

matt (eng-reliability): Proposed quick runbook snippet for the load runner:
```
# run vegeta-style mixed workload (example)
echo '{"input":"<sample prompts>","mode":"generate"}' | vegeta attack -rate=400 -duration=30m -connections=250 -header="Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" | vegeta report -type=json > mercator_400qps_30m.json
# admixture step for embed traffic at 30% rate
```
(We will adapt to our internal runner, but this is the shape.)

maria (acct): Also need a ballpark cost for their finance team. They asked hosted per-token vs reserved dedicated delta and an example monthly #s. Can Ops/Finance draft a quick estimate?

noah (finance): Quick back-of-envelope: assume 400 QPS sustained, 160 tokens avg/request (in+out), 86,400s/month -> requests/month = 400*86,400 = 34,560,000 reqs; tokens/month = 5.53B tokens. If hosted rate = $0.0003/token => ~$1.66M/mo. Dedicated reserved capacity typically lands ~5-8x cheaper depending on commit (ballpark $200k-350k/mo for this sustained throughput). I'll produce a proper table after we know batching / cache benefits.

kala (eng-runtime): That hosted number will drop significantly with prefix/KV caching and batching. For gen-heavy flows with 70% reuse, effective tokens served can fall 25-40%. We'll include a calibrated estimate after a baseline run.

security (sec): Mercator needs: SOC2 attestation, SSO (SAML/OIDC), KMS support (BYOK / HSM option), and a vendor security questionnaire. They flagged data residency and audit logging. If they require HSM-backed keys and private deployment we should flag timeline (private deploy ~4-8w).

matt (eng-reliability): For acceptance criteria for the POC: 30m sustained at target with p95 <120ms in each region, no errors >0.5%, failover test from NA->EU <3s for routing policy, and a reproducible load script + dashboard links.

kala (eng-runtime): I'll prepare two model configs:
- model-a: fp16 (primary)
- model-b: q4_0 (fallback, lower cost, slightly higher quality risk)
We'll test automatic fallback when queueing latency exceeds threshold.

ops-bot: Scheduled run created: mercator-poc-1745055555, start=2025-06-12T18:00:00Z, duration=3h window (includes prep + soak). Assigned to @matt, @kala.

jess (sales): Great. Who can draft the one-page runbook + cost slide for the prospect by EOD? I'll send it to Mercator and ask them to confirm the model selection.

matt (eng-reliability): I'll own the runbook and baseline metrics. ETA EOD today for the plan, smoke run tomorrow morning.

kala (eng-runtime): I'll produce the heatmap scripts and the fallback config. Will include a small snippet for how we instrument KV cache metrics.

security (sec): I'll start the vendor questionnaire and confirm what we can share publicly (SOC2 report). If they insist on HSM in scope, loop in infra-sales for Private deployment timeline.

maria (acct): I'll get Mercator's finance contact and ask whether they want hosted quote first or dedicated-only pricing.

noah (finance): Once we have baseline token numbers post-cache, I'll publish two scenarios: hosted (per-token) and dedicated (committed). Also include a sensitivity table for cache hit rates 0/25/50/75%.

jess (sales): Perfect. Action items: Matt (runbook + smoke), Kala (scripts + fallback), Security (vendor QA), Finance (ballpark sheet after baseline). I'll send an initial brief to Mercator with the proposed window. :thumbsup:

ben (solutions): Also note a potential enterprise blocker: Mercator legal wants a clause for model provenance & evals. Recommend we include a short quality/regression guardrail in the contract (we can reference Redwood Optimize evals).

jess (sales): Good catch — I'll loop in legal. Closing note: keep thread for quick status updates during the run.

matt (eng-reliability): 1 more thing — please ask Mercator to provide a 10-sample seed set we can use for quality checks during the run (we'll capture model deltas).

jess (sales): Will request samples now.

maria (acct): sending contact now -> finance@mercator.example.com

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: mercator-poc-1745055555 starts in 24h.
